what: Devon Energy produces oil and natural gas in the United States, with its largest position in the Delaware basin in West Texas and New Mexico, plus acreage in Oklahoma, Wyoming and North Dakota.
customers: Refiners, gas processors and crude buyers in North America.
money: Oil, gas and natural gas liquids
production from the Delaware basin and four other US basins
gathering and marketing of its own and third-party volumes
moat: A deep inventory of low-cost drilling locations in the Delaware basin, the most productive part of the Permian.
risks: Oil and gas prices set earnings
Debt of about $11 billion against very little cash
Shale wells decline quickly, so capital spending must continue
Revenue has fallen about 5% a year over three years
opportunities: Analysts see about 40% upside from current levels
A variable dividend policy returns more cash when prices are high
watch: Delaware basin well productivity and free cash flow per share.
